t: Erbauer ERI1080MLT 18V multi-tool featuring V2 brushless motor to deliver up to 35% more power and 60% higher no-load speed than the previous model, with up to 80% less vibration. Supplied with 2.0Ah battery and charger. Additionally, constant speed technology boosts efficiency, providing 18,000 OPM for effortless cutting, sanding, scraping and demolition. Also features dual LED light system to ensure precise visibility, and quick clamp for fast, tool-free accessory change, maximising productivity. Low vibration system allows user to work more comfortably for longer periods, and the the variable speed control offers fine-tuned performance for every task. Overload and overcurrent protection. Compatible with most branded accessories.
